headline: Last session: Nifty reclaimed 23,000 as Sensex gained 308 points; IndiGo and HCLTech led the gains.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: The Nifty 50 reclaimed the 23,000 level during the last trading session, closing above 23,050.
The Sensex gained 308 points to settle at 74,459.53, supported by large-cap stocks.
IndiGo shares surged 4% and HCLTech rose 2%, providing significant upward momentum.
Positive sentiment was bolstered by the government releasing an extra tax devolution tranche to states.
whatHappening: The Indian government released an additional instalment of tax devolution worth ₹1.09 lakh crore to states in October.
SEBI is currently monitoring developments within the Tata Group, according to the market regulator's chairman.
Deutsche Bank has flagged potential risks to the US dollar amid an AI-driven equity selloff.
A new weather system, Cyclone Murasu, is threatening to hit Andhra Pradesh on November 3.
summary: In the last trading session, the Nifty 50 reclaimed the 23,000 mark while the Sensex rose by 308 points. Top gainers included IndiGo and HCLTech, although mid and small-cap segments lagged behind. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday.
